'''Adam Polkinghorne''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 5th at [[May 2001 Munich tournament]] on 19 May 2001 with [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB]], according to Quirin Fürgut's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2329">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-20-munich-ralltiir-5-19-01d2329/ munich-ralltiir-5-19-01], DeckTech (Quirin "el-diablo" Fuergut, 20 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-20-munich-ralltiir-5-19-01d2329/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
